entities.summary: Hans Podlipnik Castillo is a Chilean tennis coach and a former player of Slovenian descent. He has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 43 achieved in February 2018. He won one ATP Tour doubles title. He also reached a best singles ranking in August 2015, at No. 157.
